name: integration-titlebar
description: Slim sticky title bar for an integration detail page: the partner logo + Asset Panda PRO mark beside the eyebrow and page title. Slides in under the site header once the hero's H1 has left the viewport (Figma 'Sticky Title Bar', 7333:171865). Place it right after integration-hero.

title.description: Page title, as in the hero H1 (e.g. 'Slack + Asset Panda PRO').

brand_logo.description: Asset Panda mark; empty uses the kit's panda PRO mark.

watch.description: CSS selector of the heading whose departure shows the bar; falls back to the page's first H1.
